conventions.oscillators: a1^+, a1^- odd with {a1^-, a1^+} = 1; b_j^+, b_j^- even with [b_k^-, b_l^+] = delta_kl; K = 1
conventions.deformation: [b_j^s, a1^sigma] = - gb_{sigma,j,s} kappa; gb are complex scalars
conventions.bracket_decomposition: [Z_i, Z_j] = sum_k c[i][j][k] Z_k + kappa (sum_k gamma[i][j][k] Z_k + gamma0[i][j])
conventions.linearity: gamma, gamma0, f, f_scalar are linear in gb; entries are given per gb direction alpha (coefficient of gb[alpha])
conventions.ordering: odd generators written as a1^sigma b_l^s (fermion first) as in docs/math/Cn1_definition.md
conventions.normalisation: E_{2 delta_k} = (b_k^+)^2 and E_{-2 delta_k} = (b_k^-)^2 (no factor 1/2); h_k = b_k^+ b_k^- + 1/2; N = a1^+ a1^- - 1/2

f_explicit.description: f[m][i][alpha]: coefficient of gb[alpha] in phi_{m i}; induced by a1^sigma -> a1^sigma + kappa u^sigma, u^sigma = sum_j (gb_{sigma,j,-} b_j^+ - gb_{sigma,j,+} b_j^-), f = -(kappa-part)

f_homotopy.description: second primitive: f_N(Y) = gamma_gb(N, Y) / (n(target) - n(Y)), n = ad_N eigenvalue (epsilon-coordinate of the weight); scalar part f_N''(Y) = gamma0(N,Y)/(-n(Y))

cohomology.module: Pi g (adjoint with parity reversed) = odd cochains

conclusion: gamma_gb is a coboundary for ALL values of gb (no condition); moreover H^2(g, Pi g) = 0.
